verses.gurmukhi: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਲੋਭ ਮੋਹ ਅਹੰਮੇਵ ਕੈ ਅਸਾਧ ਸਾਧ ਸਤ ਧਰਮ ਦਇਆਰਥ ਸੰਤੋਖ ਕੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: kaam krodh lobh moh aha(n)mev kai asaadh saadh sat dharam dhiaarath sa(n)tokh kai ||

en.bdb: Self-willed persons remain engrossed in vices like lust, anger, greed, attachment, pride, whereas Guru-conscious persons are kind, sympathetic and contented.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗ ਭਾਵਨੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਭਾਇ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਕੈ ਅਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਿ ਦੁਖ ਦੋਖ ਕੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: gurmat saadh sa(n)g bhaavanee bhagat bhai dhuramat kai asaadh sa(n)g dhukh dhokh kai ||

en.bdb: In the company of saintly persons, one attains faith, love and devotion; whereas in the company of base and fake people, one gets pain, suffering and base wisdom.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨ ਸਰਨਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਮੋਖ ਪਦ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਚਿਤ ਚੋਖ ਕੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: janam maran gur charan saran bin mokh padh charan kamal chit chokh kai ||

en.bdb: Without the refuge of the True Guru self-oriented persons fall in the cycle of birth and death. Obedient Sikhs of the Guru drink deep the nectar of Guru's words, imbibe them in their heart and thus achieve salvation.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਨ ਅੰਸ ਹੰਸ ਗਤਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੰਸ ਬਿਖੈ ਦੁਕ੍ਰਿਤ ਸੁਕ੍ਰਿਤ ਖੀਰ ਨੀਰ ਸੋਖ ਪੋਖ ਕੈ ॥੨੮੭॥
verses.translit_en: giaan a(n)s ha(n)s gat gurmukh ba(n)s bikhai dhukirat sukirat kheer neer sokh pokh kai ||287||

en.bdb: In the clan of Guru-conscious persons, knowledge is clean and invaluable like swans. Just as a swan is capable of separating milk from water, so do the Guru-oriented Sikhs discard all that is base and feel satiated with superior deeds. (287)
